title: Mike Macdonald praises Tory Horton's "tremendous play" on late kickoff return

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Macdonald praises Tory Horton's "tremendous play" on late kickoff return
sources.description: After the Raiders cut the Seahawks' lead to 21-13 by kicking a field goal with 2:04 left in Sunday's game, they wanted to force a touchback that would allow them to use the two-minute warning as a third timeout in hopes of getting the ball back.
